name: Prepare and verify a Python workspace
description: Create a project folder, edit a Python file in VS Code, select the intended interpreter, and run it from PowerShell.

name: Run scripts and communicate with text
description: Use print, input, strings, numeric conversion, and formatted strings in a repeatable saved program.

name: Read and repair an early Python failure
description: Use the command, traceback, exception type, line, and caret to repair a wrong path, syntax error, name error, or indentation error.

name: Represent and calculate with Python values
description: Use readable variables, integers, floats, strings, Booleans, arithmetic operators, precedence, and explicit conversion.

name: Express ordered decisions
description: Use comparisons, Boolean operators, and if/elif/else in an order that produces one explainable result.

name: Recover from invalid numeric input
description: Use try/except ValueError around the smallest conversion boundary without hiding unrelated defects.

name: Repeat until a condition changes
description: Use while, a deliberate state update, break, and a defensible loop condition without creating an accidental infinite loop.

name: Process ordered data with lists and for loops
description: Create, index, update, append, and traverse a list while respecting zero-based boundaries.

name: Model named records with dictionaries
description: Create, read, update, test, and iterate dictionary keys and values for understandable records and summaries.

name: Define and call focused functions
description: Write functions with purposeful names and parameters, then call them with appropriate arguments.

name: Return and compose useful values
description: Return values rather than relying on incidental printing, and combine focused functions into a larger calculation.

name: Reason about local scope and mutation
description: Distinguish local names from outer names and avoid hidden dependence on mutable global state.

name: Address files with pathlib
description: Build a project-relative Path, inspect whether it exists, and avoid depending on an unexplained working-directory assumption.

name: Read and write text defensively
description: Use with blocks and explicit UTF-8 encoding while distinguishing a missing file from an existing unreadable or malformed file.

name: Round-trip JSON data safely
description: Serialize supported Python data to JSON text and load it back without confusing JSON data with executable Python objects.

name: Create simple class instances
description: Define a class initializer, construct independent instances, and distinguish instance attributes from local variables.

name: Change object state through methods
description: Write and call a small instance method that validates and changes the intended object without altering unrelated instances.

name: Separate a program into modules
description: Import focused functions or classes from local modules and avoid accidentally executing application code during import.

name: Protect an application entry point
description: Use a main function and the __name__ guard so a file behaves deliberately when run and when imported.

name: Verify behavior with unittest
description: Write deterministic tests with assertEqual, assertRaises, and isolated temporary data for normal, boundary, and invalid behavior.

name: Inspect a failing case with the debugger
description: Set a breakpoint, step through one failing case, inspect local values, repair one cause, and rerun the same test.

name: Parse a small command-line interface
description: Use argparse to define commands or options, validate supplied values, and provide usable help without hand-parsing fragile strings.

name: Document and publish a safe Git repository
description: Write reproducible setup, run, and test instructions, inspect staged paths, commit locally, and push a secret-free project to GitHub.
